tool_schemas.name: list_invoices
tool_schemas.description: List invoices, optionally for one vendor (by vendor name).

tool_schemas.name: send_wire
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by wire from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: send_ach
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by ACH from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: list_payments
tool_schemas.description: List payments sent from the operating account.

tool_schemas.name: link_payment
tool_schemas.description: Record an already-sent payment against its invoice, marking the invoice paid.

trace.question:
I haven't sent any payment yet. You asked me to pay Borealis Freight's approved invoice, but they have two approved invoices, and I need you to tell me which one to pay.

**Borealis Freight (V-529) invoices:**
| Invoice | Amount | Status | Due |
|---|---|---|---|
| INV-29161 | $3,308.08 | **approved** | 2026-11-04 |
| INV-60893 | $7,366.39 | **approved** | 2026-11-25 |
| INV-59731 | $3,174.69 | draft (awaiting approval) | 2026-11-28 |
| INV-76947 | $5,554.38 | already paid | 2026-09-30 |

No payments have gone out from the operating account yet, so neither approved invoice has been paid. Both are under $10,000, so neither needs controller approval.

Payments can't be undone without a clawback, so I didn't want to guess. Tell me which invoice to pay, or say if you want both paid. I'll send it by wire, or by ACH if wires aren't available. I'll pay each invoice only once and then report the payment details.

trace.message: Pay INV-60893, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.text: Pay INV-60893, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.final:
I paid INV-60893 in full by wire, and it went out once.

**Payment details:**
- **Payment ID:** PAY0001
- **Invoice:** INV-60893 (Borealis Freight, V-529, due 2026-11-25)
- **Amount:** $7,366.39 (the full invoice amount)
- **Method:** Wire from the operating account
- **Status:** Sent. The invoice is now marked **paid**.

I sent it with a unique idempotency key (a tag that stops the same payment from going out twice). The operating account's payment list shows only this one payment, so there's no duplicate. It's under $10,000, so it didn't need controller approval.

I didn't pay INV-29161 ($3,308.08), since you said it's under dispute; it's still listed as approved. INV-59731 is still a draft waiting for approval.
